Inline MediaTrackConstraints bag passed to navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia. echoCancellation/noiseSuppression/autoGainControl are independent browser audio constraint toggles, not exclusive capture phases.

Independent sanitizer predicates for different CSS tokens (selector keys vs color values). A safe key with an unsafe color and the reverse are both representable; ChartStyle ANDs them per entry rather than masking a union.

Layered SVG sanitizer predicates: root document checks, per-element checks, and the whole-svg aggregator. Unsafe roots and unsafe descendants can coexist; the aggregator ANDs free combinations rather than encoding exclusive sanitizer phases.
